input.summary: Theatre Calgary’s season-opening musical: a timid shop assistant, a plant with a taste for blood, and a very dark comedy.

input.title: ScreamFest at Stampede Park
input.summary: Calgary's big Halloween night out: haunted houses, rides and scare zones at GMC Stadium.
input.description: ScreamFest takes over GMC Stadium at Stampede Park from 7 pm to midnight on select October nights, with haunted houses, scare zones and midway rides. Much of it is outdoors, so dress for the weather. Tickets are sold online; one night is 18+ only, so check the official site for that date and current prices. Parking is on Stampede Park and the Erlton/Stampede CTrain station is next door.
